# Tracked files carry no home path of a local account
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #370, sha256:9567046ece6d522d8cbaffd2936bf9f63f5ef9880a83059c48b143e38525792d). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** story
- **Repository:** avowry (tracked files)
- **Source:** product-owner answers to the nine owner items on docs/release/pre-publication-checks.md, inbox entry of 2026-11-08 (card 186). Ranked before the v0.1 publish card.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Dana, I want no tracked file to carry a home path of a local account, so that publishing the repository does not publish where its maintainer works.
- **Consumer value:** Dana and the sponsor persona publish a tree with no account name in any path.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [O][S] none remain in the tree
     Given the 146 tracked files that carry a home path (card 186 page)
     When the paths are replaced by a neutral form
     Then a scan of the tracked tree finds no home path of a local account
  2. Scenario: [Z][E] nothing else changes and history stays
     Given the tracked files other than those paths
     When the scrub runs
     Then their text is unchanged, no file is deleted, and history is left as it is (public)
  3. Scenario: [I] a guard
     Given the commit hook and the secrets check
     When a home path is added to a tracked file
     Then the check fails, naming the file
- **Not in this card:** Rewriting git history; deleting files.
- **Size:** M
